cards.target: Kaç yaşındasınız?
cards.english: How old are you?

cards.target: Merhaba, nerelisiniz?
cards.english: Hello, where are you from?

cards.target: Eve yeni geldik.
cards.english: We have just arrived home.

cards.target: Saat kaçta başlıyor?
cards.english: What time does it start?

cards.target: sık sık anlıyor mu?
cards.english: Does he/she often understand?

cards.target: Doktor dikkatsizce fotoğraf çekiyor.
cards.english: The doctor takes photos carelessly.

cards.target: Arabanı nereye park ettin?
cards.english: Where did you park your car?

cards.target: Toplantı saat kaçta bitiyor?
cards.english: What time does the meeting end?

cards.target: Üniversiteye hangi otobüs gider?
cards.english: Which bus goes to the university?

cards.target: Bu filmi daha önce gördüm.
cards.english: I've seen this movie before.

cards.target: Neden bu kadar geç kaldınız?
cards.english: Why were you so late?

cards.target: Hoşça kal, kendine iyi bak.
cards.english: Goodbye, take care of yourself.

cards.target: Bu filmi daha önce izlemedim.
cards.english: I haven't watched this movie before.
cards.existing: Negation slots in before the tense suffix: `geliyorum` (I'm coming) → `gelmiyorum` (I'm not coming). The `-mi-/-mı-/-mu-/-mü-` slot lives between root and tense.

cards.target: Efendim, size nasıl yardımcı olabilirim?
cards.english: Sir/Madam, how may I help you?

cards.target: Annem her sabah kahvaltı hazırlar.
cards.english: My mother prepares breakfast every morning.
cards.existing: Turkish goes Subject-Object-Verb: the verb is the final word. `Ben kitap okuyorum` = 'I book am-reading' = 'I'm reading a book'. The verb wraps everything up.

cards.target: Bu oda boş mu, kalabilir miyim?
cards.english: Is this room free, can I stay?

cards.target: Genç kadın yaşlı adama yardım etti.
cards.english: The young woman helped the old man.

cards.target: Yardıma ihtiyacım var, bana yardım eder misin?
cards.english: I need help, can you help me?

cards.target: Eczacı mektubu okulda bitirdi.
cards.english: The pharmacist finished the letter at school.

cards.target: Bu kitabın yazarı kim?
cards.english: Who is the author of this book?
cards.existing: Possession is baked into the noun: `evim` (my house), `evin` (your house), `evi` (his/her house). No separate 'my', 'your', etc. – just suffix the owner onto the thing.

cards.target: Gürültülü komşular yüzünden uyuyamıyoruz.
cards.english: We can't sleep because of noisy neighbors.

cards.target: Arkeolog dün restorana gitti.
cards.english: The archaeologist went to the restaurant yesterday.
cards.existing: Dative `-e/-a` = 'to / toward': `eve` (to home), `okula` (to school). Mandatory with motion verbs: `eve gidiyorum` (I'm going home).

cards.target: Sis çökünce ışıkları yaktım.
cards.english: When the fog descended, I turned on the lights.

cards.target: Çocuklar büyüyünce ne olacak?
cards.english: What will become of the children when they grow up?

cards.target: Öğrenciler sınıfta sınava hazırlanıyorlar.
cards.english: The students are preparing for the exam in the classroom.

cards.target: Bu çanta yaklaşık beş kilo.
cards.english: This bag weighs about five kilos.

cards.target: Bu otobüs Taksim'e gidiyor mu?
cards.english: Does this bus go to Taksim?

cards.target: Akşam yemeğini dışarıda yemeyi düşünüyorum.
cards.english: I'm thinking of eating dinner out.

cards.target: Dedem uzun bir mektubu tercüme ediyor.
cards.english: My grandfather is translating a long letter.

cards.target: Bu ilaç ağrıyı çabucak geçiriyor.
cards.english: This medicine relieves the pain quickly.

cards.target: İnşallah yarın hava güzel olur.
cards.english: Hopefully the weather will be nice tomorrow.

cards.target: Mahallemizde yeni bir market açıldı.
cards.english: A new market opened in our neighborhood.

cards.target: Hediyeyi güzelce paketledim ve gönderdim.
cards.english: I wrapped the gift nicely and sent it.

cards.target: Bunu nereden aldınız, çok güzel?
cards.english: Where did you buy this? It's very nice.

cards.target: Günaydın, kahvaltı hazırlığım bitmek üzere.
cards.english: Good morning, I'm almost done preparing breakfast.

cards.target: Günaydın, bugün hava çok güzel.
cards.english: Good morning, the weather is very nice today.

cards.target: Restoranda kuzu kebabı sipariş ettim.
cards.english: I ordered a lamb kebab at the restaurant.

cards.target: Mahallenin en güzel evi bizimki.
cards.english: The most beautiful house in the neighborhood is ours.

cards.target: Mutfakta yemek yaparken parmağımı kestim.
cards.english: I cut my finger while cooking in the kitchen.

cards.target: Masada duran vazo anneannemden kalma.
cards.english: The vase standing on the table is inherited from my grandmother.

cards.target: Balıkçı bugün üç büyük balık tuttu.
cards.english: The fisherman caught three large fish today.

cards.target: Güneş enerjisi panelleri çatıya monte edildi.
cards.english: Solar energy panels were installed on the roof.

cards.target: Ne haber, son zamanlarda neler yapıyorsun?
cards.english: What's up, what have you been doing lately?

cards.target: Bu mağazada çok güzel kıyafetler satıyorlar.
cards.english: They sell very nice clothes at this store.

cards.target: Öğretmenimizin dersleri çok ilginç ve eğlenceli.
cards.english: Our teacher's lessons are very interesting and fun.
cards.existing: Both ends must match: if owner is in genitive, the thing must carry the possessive suffix. Drop either one and the sentence collapses.

cards.target: Pastanede çay ve pasta sipariş ettik.
cards.english: We ordered tea and pastries at the patisserie.

cards.target: Diş hekimi tiyatroda fotoğraf çekiyor.
cards.english: The dentist is taking photos at the theater.

cards.target: Çay hazır, bir fincan ister misin?
cards.english: The tea is ready, would you like a cup?

cards.target: İstanbul'da yazın hava çok sıcak olur.
cards.english: The weather is very hot in Istanbul in summer.

cards.target: Arkadaşlar bu sabah stadyumda müziği sessizce dinliyor.
cards.english: The friends are quietly listening to the music at the stadium this morning.

cards.target: Doktor ona bir hafta dinlenmesini söyledi.
cards.english: The doctor told him to rest for a week.

cards.target: Bu tabak çok güzel, nerede buldunuz?
cards.english: This plate is very beautiful, where did you find it?

cards.target: Sanatçı atölyesinde yeni bir tablo yapıyor.
cards.english: The artist is making a new painting in his studio.

cards.target: O sırada telefonda konuşuyordum, kapıyı duymadım.
cards.english: I was talking on the phone at that time, I didn't hear the door.
cards.existing: Negation slots in before the tense suffix: `geliyorum` (I'm coming) → `gelmiyorum` (I'm not coming). The `-mi-/-mı-/-mu-/-mü-` slot lives between root and tense.

cards.target: Yoğurt ile vişne bir arada güzel olur.
cards.english: Yogurt and sour cherry go well together.

cards.target: İnsanlara güvenmek ama dikkatli olmak da gerekir.
cards.english: One should trust people but also be careful.

cards.target: Bu akşam ne yemek yapalım, ne dersiniz?
cards.english: What shall we cook tonight, what do you say?

cards.target: Derin mavi denizde yüzmek harika bir duygu.
cards.english: Swimming in the deep blue sea is a wonderful feeling.

cards.target: Müdür şafakta stadyumda ışıkları tamir etti.
cards.english: The director repaired the lights at the stadium at dawn.

cards.target: Restorana doğru yürürken güzel bir çeşme gördük.
cards.english: While walking towards the restaurant we saw a beautiful fountain.

cards.target: Meydanda taze hava ve temiz su bulabilirsiniz.
cards.english: In the square you can find fresh air and clean water.

cards.target: Hızlı tren İstanbul'dan Ankara'ya dört saatte gidiyor.
cards.english: The fast train goes from Istanbul to Ankara in four hours.

cards.target: Cerrah dün ameliyathanede altı saat boyunca çalıştı.
cards.english: The surgeon worked in the operating room for six hours yesterday.

cards.target: Arkeolog her sabah stadyumda eski duvarları boyardı.
cards.english: The archaeologist used to paint the old walls at the stadium every morning.

cards.target: Öğrenciler öğleden sonra eski köprüye gezi yaptı.
cards.english: The students took a trip to the old bridge in the afternoon.

cards.target: Dar sokaklar tarihi dokunun en güzel parçası.
cards.english: The narrow streets are the most beautiful part of the historical heritage.

cards.target: Timsah nehir kenarında güneşte ısınır ve uyur.
cards.english: The crocodile warms up in the sun by the river and sleeps.

cards.target: Bu çayın kokusu çok hoş, hangi çeşit?
cards.english: The smell of this tea is very pleasant, what kind is it?
cards.existing: Possession 'X of Y' takes two suffixes: -in (genitive) on the owner, -i (possessive) on the thing. `Ali'nin kitabı` = 'Ali's book' literally 'of-Ali book-his'.

cards.target: Yeni bir hobi edinmek istiyorum, ne önerirsiniz?
cards.english: I want to pick up a new hobby, what do you suggest?

cards.target: Dün parkta koşarken eski bir arkadaşıma rastladım.
cards.english: Yesterday while running in the park I ran into an old friend.

cards.target: Hemşire öğleden sonra pazarda taze balık gördü.
cards.english: The nurse saw fresh fish at the market in the afternoon.

cards.target: Saat altıda alarm kurdum, erken kalkmam lazım.
cards.english: I set the alarm for six o'clock, I need to wake up early.
cards.existing: `-ken` = 'while X-ing': `çocukken` (while a child), `yürürken` (while walking). Attaches to nouns, adjectives, or verb-progressive forms.

cards.target: On birden on ikiye kadar matematik dersi var.
cards.english: There's math class from eleven to twelve.

cards.target: Ben bazen alışveriş listesi hazırlarım ve eve dönerim.
cards.english: Sometimes I prepare a shopping list and return home.
cards.existing: Buffer 's' after vowel-ending nouns: `araba` → `arabası` (his/her car). 'a' meets 'i' so 's' breaks them apart. Same for `kutu → kutusu`.

cards.target: Bu kitabın fiyatı elli lira, indirimle otuz beş.
cards.english: This book's price is fifty lira, thirty-five with discount.

cards.target: Festivalde geleneksel el sanatları ve yöresel lezzetler sunuldu.
cards.english: Traditional handicrafts and local delicacies were offered at the festival.

cards.target: Yeğenim için bir doğum günü hediyesi almam lazım.
cards.english: I need to buy a birthday present for my nephew.

cards.target: Çiftçi her sabah göl kenarında balık pişirirdi.
cards.english: The farmer used to cook fish by the lake every morning.

cards.target: Ali dün yüzme havuzunda bozuk pompayı tamir etti.
cards.english: Ali repaired the broken pump at the swimming pool yesterday.

cards.target: Acı biber yemeğe lezzet katıyor ama dikkatli olmalısınız.
cards.english: Hot pepper adds flavor to food but you should be careful.

cards.target: Diş hekimi öğleden sonra tiyatroda koltukları temizledi.
cards.english: The dentist cleaned the seats at the theater in the afternoon.

cards.target: Diş hekimi bayramda camide kapıyı tamir etti.
cards.english: The dentist repaired the door at the mosque during the holiday.

cards.target: Diş hekimi dün akşam restoranda dolma pişirdi.
cards.english: The dentist cooked dolma at the restaurant last night.

cards.target: Annem geçen hafta odayı mavi renge boyadı.
cards.english: My mother painted the room blue last week.

cards.target: Arkadaşım bugün alışveriş listesi hazırladı ama pek beğenmedi.
cards.english: My friend prepared a shopping list today but didn't really like it.

cards.target: Yazar akşamüstü stadyumda notlarını topladı.
cards.english: The writer gathered his notes at the stadium in the late afternoon.

cards.target: Sapasağlam bir bina, hiç eskimemiş.
cards.english: A perfectly solid building, hasn't aged at all.

cards.target: hafta sonu Doktor stadyumda üzüntüyle bakıyor.
cards.english: On weekends the doctor is looking sadly at the stadium.

cards.target: hafta içi Veteriner alışveriş merkezinde merakla tercüme ediyor.
cards.english: On weekdays the vet interprets eagerly at the shopping mall.

cards.target: Profesör sizi sempozyuma konuşmacı olarak davet etmek istiyor.
cards.english: The professor wants to invite you as a speaker to the symposium.

cards.target: Organik tarım ürünlerine olan talep her geçen gün artıyor.
cards.english: Demand for organic agricultural products increases day by day.

cards.target: Orkestra şefi provaya devam etmek zorunda kaldı çünkü konser yaklaşıyordu.
cards.english: The orchestra conductor had to continue rehearsing because the concert was approaching.

cards.target: Kahverengi ayakkabılarım.
cards.english: My brown shoes.
